description: Implementation of the Executor class for managing graph execution, including initialization, weight management, input validation, frame pooling, and execution control within the torch::nativert namespace.

classes.name: Executor
classes.description: Manages graph execution, including initialization, weight updates, input validation, frame pooling, and execution control.

methods.name: Executor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the executor with configuration, graph, weights, and stream reader.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the executor, sets up kernels, graph executor, and layout planner.

methods.name: atomicSwapWeights
methods.description: Atomically swaps the current weights with new weights and updates delegate executors.

methods.name: maybeRunConstantFolding
methods.description: Performs constant folding on the graph if enabled.

methods.name: processWeights
methods.description: Processes and updates weights, including constant folding and delegate executors.

methods.name: initWeights
methods.description: Initializes weights and runs constant folding if needed.

methods.name: validateInputs
methods.description: Validates input tensors' dtype and device against expected metadata.

methods.name: getExecutorFrameFromPool
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an execution frame from the pool.

methods.name: clearStaleExecutionFrames
methods.description: Clears inactive or stale execution frames from the pool.

methods.name: returnExecutorFrameToPool
methods.description: Returns an execution frame to the pool, with optional cleanup.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the graph with given inputs.

methods.name: execute (overload)
methods.description: Executes the graph with args, kwargs, and input tree specification.

methods.name: benchmarkIndividualNodes
methods.description: Benchmarks individual nodes with provided inputs.

methods.name: getDelegates
methods.description: Returns a list of delegate executors.
